video_title: Toronto Raptors Full Media Availability | Practice | October 14, 2026

quotes.speaker: Gradey Dick
quotes.summary_phrase: Gradey Dick on building confidence for his three-point shot
quotes.excerpt: just build that confidence to shoot it more. I think that was my biggest focus
quotes.quote: I just build that confidence to shoot it more. I think that was my biggest focus, not really trying to fix my jumper or anything like that, just getting confident with getting shots up. Obviously, me reading the defense is the biggest part. If they're sagging off of me, then I have to shoot it. We want to shoot more threes, we want to get to that 35-ish per game number, so just helping the team out with that as much as possible.
quotes.social_post: Gradey Dick says the Raptors are aiming for a high volume of three-point attempts this season, targeting around 35 per game to help the team offense.

quotes.speaker: Gradey Dick
quotes.summary_phrase: Gradey Dick on learning his new role and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: me coming to a new role on this team, still some things I got to learn
quotes.quote: In certain aspects, I'm still getting used to it. Me coming to a new role on this team, still some things I got to learn. Good thing I have good people, good teammates around me to help me through that and teach me what to do when it comes to on-ball situations and stuff like that, reading help side. Of course, I know what the season is, I know what is to come. I know how players play, I know how fast the game goes, so I'm prepared in that aspect, but you know, still learning.
quotes.social_post: Gradey Dick admits he is still adjusting to his new role on the team but feels prepared for the speed of the NBA season.

quotes.speaker: Gradey Dick
quotes.summary_phrase: Gradey Dick on the impact of playing with Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: he's one of the best shot makers, one of the best defenders, one of the best players
quotes.quote: It was good. He's one of the best shot makers, one of the best defenders, one of the best players. So, to have him on the court, obviously see what he does, it's just amazing for me. It gets my energy up. He set the tone early, and that's just, you know, we have a young team. Having guys like that that set the tone, it's something that we're going to need.
quotes.social_post: Gradey Dick on playing with Kawhi Leonard: It was good. He is one of the best shot makers and defenders, and having him on the court sets the tone for our young team.

quotes.speaker: Gradey Dick
quotes.summary_phrase: Gradey Dick on the team's defensive potential this season
quotes.excerpt: it's going to be a nightmare for any team if we're all dialed in
quotes.quote: I don't think we have a limit to how good we can be. If we're all dialed in, I feel like it's going to be a nightmare for any team if we're all on the same page. It's more mental than than our ability, I feel like. Even if we didn't have the best defenders, I think more just being on the same page when it comes to help and rotations and stuff like that, if a player gets beat, who can be there, step up for him. I think that's going to be our biggest thing to focus on when it comes to how good our defense can be.
quotes.social_post: Gradey Dick believes the Raptors defensive potential is limitless if the team stays on the same page, noting that success is more mental than physical ability.

quotes.speaker: Gradey Dick
quotes.summary_phrase: Gradey Dick on his defensive approach against premier big men
quotes.excerpt: me really being who I am and pressure the ball as much as possible
quotes.quote: I just get back to what I am used to. I feel like those first two preseason games I wasn't really being as on-ball as I normally am. I wasn't really pressuring them as much, you know, just being lax and that side. So me really being who I am and pressure the ball as much as possible, disrupt ball handlers, I feel like as long as I do that, I have a really good chance at getting steals and making effort plays for my team.
quotes.social_post: Gradey Dick says he is focusing on being more aggressive on the ball and pressuring handlers to disrupt the offense after a lax start to the preseason.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Going into the game, you look at that 16 or 18 minute stretch of starters or your top rotation players together. What about that was encouraging and can you get a fair measure given that you're playing against the next second or third unit mostly?

text_blocks.speaker: Darko Rajaković
text_blocks.text: Going into the game, we talked to guys that we don't control who's going to show up on the other side and who's going to be playing or not. We got to take games seriously and that it has to be about us and our standards and how we want to play. Guys did a really good job. They took a professional approach to it. I think there was a lot of excitement just playing first home game, a lot of excitement to see Kawhi playing back in Toronto, and all the guys they just wanted to go out there and play a good game to open up the season at home. Take it for what it is, it's very hard to make any conclusions based on 16, 17 minutes of those guys playing together.

quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says it is very hard to make any conclusions based on the limited minutes the starters played together in the preseason opener.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on the team's offensive and defensive pillars
quotes.excerpt: we have our five offensive pillars and we have five defensive pillars
quotes.quote: We have our five offensive pillars and we have five defensive pillars, and through those we're measuring a lot of things that they need to help our defense. They mimic our identity as a team.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says the Raptors are using five offensive and five defensive pillars to measure and define the team identity this season.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on roster flexibility and rotation depth
quotes.excerpt: we're going to go into the season being flexible as well
quotes.quote: We have two more games, we have a couple more practices under the belt over here for all of those guys to try different lineups, to see who's playing well off of each other. Start of the season is soon, but I think we're going to go into the season being flexible as well. It's going to really depend on a lot of factors, who are going to be nine or 10 or 11 guys in rotation, and we're not going to shy away from throwing different guys in the fire over there and giving them opportunity.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says the Raptors will remain flexible with their rotation to start the season and are not afraid to throw different players into the fire to see who performs.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on his expectations for Gradey Dick's shot selection
quotes.excerpt: I promise him this morning, first time when I see him that he does not take open shot
quotes.quote: I don't care if the shot is going to fall or not. He is a great shooter, I want him to to shoot the ball. I promise him this morning, first time when I see him that he does not take open shot, I'm going to sit him on the bench. So it's going to be simple as that. He is a great shooter, he has a great feel for the game, and yesterday was a typical rookie game playing for the first time in in front of home crowd.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic has a clear message for Gradey Dick: If he does not take an open shot, he is going to sit on the bench. The coach wants his shooter to keep firing regardless of results.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on the importance of three-point shooting in modern basketball
quotes.excerpt: the better shooting you have, in theory should open up you more space and more paint touches
quotes.quote: Any offense, if you're making those three-point shots, it just makes defense more honest, less help, opens up the paint more. I think those things are very, very connected. The better shooting you have, in theory should open up you more space and more paint touches. And once we touch the paint, we got to convert those and we got to be also making right decisions to find, again, if defense collapses, to find open men. So super important, three-point line is very important in modern basketball.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic emphasizes the importance of the three-point line in modern basketball, noting that making shots is essential to opening up the paint and creating space.
